module: Flowgraph node "Race Start Transform" (category repeat_instant, tags scenario and race). Gives the transform of a start position of a pathData, useful for creating custom triggers. Inputs: pathData and name (string or number: name or id of the position; default = defaultStartPosition). Outputs: existing, pos (position shifted backward by half of startBoxLength and raised by half of startBoxHeight, hence the center of the start box), origPos (original position), rot (quat), scl ({width, length, height}). Computed only once (as long as self.path is nil).
notes: Data options: startBoxWidth = 2, startBoxLength = 5, startBoxHeight = 1.5, useStringMatch = false (if true, the first position whose name contains the given string is used).
If the position is absent or 'missing', existing is false and the other outputs are not updated.

init.desc: Initializes self.path, disables clearOutPinsOnStart and sets the start box options.

work.desc: Looks for the start position and computes pos, origPos, rot, scl and existing.
